messages:
Elena (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we're launching the new Peer Pulse recognition program next Wed (5/10). Monthly micro-recognition + $100 spot award pool. Nominations open for 72 hours, managers review, Finance issues payments. Will post a comms kit today. :tada:

Sam (Eng): Nice! What's eligibility? Anyone can nominate anyone? :eyes:

Elena (People Ops): Yep — all FT + contractors who've been with Redwood >=30 days. You can nominate up to 3 people/month. Managers will approve nominations for their directs (aim for 48h review).

Priya (Product): Can you share the rubric so we can prep team comms?

Elena (People Ops): Rubric's embedded in the form link below — three short criteria: Impact (measurable result), Teamwork (helped unblock/mentored), Customer Obs (direct customer benefit). Keep nominations <200 words and include one concrete example. I'll drop a comms kit (copy + screenshot) after standup.

Darren (Finance): Budget check — how many awards/month? Need GL code and workflow for payments. Also payroll cutoff?

Elena (People Ops): We budgeted $5k/month (~50 awards). GL: 4-122-REC. Approver flow: manager -> people ops review -> finance final sign-off for payout. Payroll cutoff: approvals must be complete by the last day of the month 12:00 PM PT to hit the next payday. For any award >$500 route to Darren for manual review.

people-ops-bot: Form created: https://forms.gle/peer-pulse-formsample (nominations go live 2026-05-10 09:00 PT). Pin set and reminder schedule will be automated.

Jorge (People Ops Intern): I'll set up the /remind schedule and the monthly highlight carousel. Volunteers for a monthly writeup? I can draft the first one.

Priya (Product): I'll grab month 1 roundup and can share a short slide for product channel.

Sam (Eng): Do managers need to opt in? Some on my team asked to be excluded from approvals for now.

Elena (People Ops): Managers can opt-out for review duties — they should email ppl-ops@redwood.com with team name and reason. Opt-out does not block team members from being nominated, it just changes who approves (we'll default to skip-level).

Sam (Eng): And timezone handling? Will this be US-timed only?

Elena (People Ops): Nominations open for 72h across regions. We'll send localized reminders at 9am local for each region. Jorge will handle region pings and pinned form per channel.

Jorge (People Ops Intern): Reminder schedule I'm planning: US: Tue 16:00 UTC (remind), EU: Wed 07:00 UTC, APAC: Wed 23:00 UTC. Slack post example: `/remind @team "Peer Pulse nominations open — fill out form: <https://forms.gle/peer-pulse-formsample>" at 09:00`

Priya (Product): Quick Q: can execs nominate?

Elena (People Ops): Yes. Exec nominations are allowed. If an exec nominates and award >$500, we'll involve ExecOps + Finance for sign-off.

Darren (Finance): Sounds good. Please send me a calendar invite for the monthly payout reconciliation. Also include export format (CSV) for approvals.

Elena (People Ops): Will do. Export fields: nominee, nominator, reason, manager approval ts, award amount. CSV header: nominee,nominator,reason,manager,approved_ts,amount,gl_code.

Sam (Eng): Thanks all. I'll remind my managers to review within 48h. :thumbsup:

Elena (People Ops): Please: 1) share the comms kit in your team channels, 2) review nominations within 48h, 3) send any opt-out requests to ppl-ops@redwood.com. Tag me or Jorge with questions or edge cases. Excited to get this rolling! :tada:
